page_data.en:
KIANGNAN ARSENAL

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. FILING
No. 550.
Date 14.10.29.）

1. Location with transportation facilities

The Kiangnan Arsenal is situated at Kao Chong Miao on
the north bank of the Whangpoo River, about half a mile south
west to Shanghai South Station. Transportation to the
Arsenal is facilitated (1) by railway (2) by the Whangpoo
River and (3) by two roads. One of the roads named the
Lunghwa Road runs from the Lunghwa Village (about 6 miles
south of Shanghai) and is about 4 miles long; and the
other named Arsenal Road runs from the St. Catherine's
Bridge, and is about 3 miles long

2. Capacity

a) Ammunition Department - (Lunghwa Branch)

The Maximum production is 120,000 rounds per day of
any of the following description of ammunition:
(1) rifle (2) machine gun (3) T. M. gun.

b) Shell Department.

About 4,000 shells for mountain guns per month.
Air bombs are manufactured at present in the Shell
Department; and the output is about 30 per month.
The heaviest bomb weighs about 20 lbs.

c) Rifle Department

This department manufactures monthly as under:
400 rifles
7 machine guns
400 pistols
30 T. M. guns.

d) Gun Department

6 mountain guns (7.5 c.m.) per month.

e) Fuse Section of the Shell Department.

About 4,000 fuses.

f) Foundary Department

About 10,000 cases for "Stokew" gun shells, and
1,500 hand grenade cases.

g) T.M. and Miscellaneous guns:

For T.M. gun, see the Rifle Department
□□□□□ Department: "□□ "Stokes" guns per month.

江南兵工厂

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处归档
第 550 号。
日期 14.10.29.）

1. 地理位置及交通设施

江南兵工厂位于黄浦江北岸的高昌庙，在上海南站西南方向约半英里处。前往兵工厂的交通方式有：(1) 铁路，(2) 黄浦江水路，以及 (3) 两条道路。其中一条名为龙华路，从龙华村（位于上海以南约6英里）延伸而来，长约4英里；另一条名为兵工厂路（Arsenal Road），从圣凯瑟琳桥（St. Catherine's Bridge）延伸而来，长约3英里。

2. 生产能力

a) 弹药部 - （龙华分部）

下列任何类型弹药的最大日产量为 120,000 发：
(1) 步枪弹 (2) 机枪弹 (3) 汤姆逊冲锋枪弹。

b) 炮弹部。

每月生产约 4,000 枚山炮炮弹。
目前炮弹部也制造航空炸弹；月产量约为 30 枚。
最重的炸弹重约 20 磅。

c) 步枪部

该部门月产量如下：
400 支步枪
7 挺机枪
400 支手枪
30 支汤姆逊冲锋枪。

d) 火炮部

每月生产 6 门山炮（7.5 厘米口径）。

e) 炮弹部引信科。

约 4,000 个引信。

f) 铸造部

约 10,000 个“斯托克斯”（Stokew）迫击炮弹壳，以及
1,500 个手榴弹壳。

g) 汤姆逊冲锋枪及其他杂项枪械：

汤姆逊冲锋枪情况见步枪部
□□□□□ 部：“□□ ”斯托克斯（Stokes）迫击炮每月 □□ 门。

3. Power Plant
The Kiangnan Arsenal has its own generating plant but
also draws a supply from the Chinese plant in Nantao.
It has altogether 22 motors with horse power ranging from
10 to 40.

4. Machinery The machinery of all departments is of German
make and has been supplied by Carlowitz & Co.

5. Personnel
Director of the Arsenal
{
General Branch
{
General Section
Estimate Section
Accounting Section
Purchasing Section
Sanitary Section
Working Branch
{
Store Department
Chief of various working departments
such as gun department etc.

The clerical staff consists of 250 persons and the
number of workmen is 3,360.

6. Material
Explosives are almost exclusively purchased from Germany
Iron, Copper and Brass are all of Chinese products and
are supplied by Chinese metal companies.
Steel is produced by a special Steel Department, up
to about 180 piculs per month, but at present it is
not working owing to lack of funds.
Fuse: The material to manufacture fuse is purchased from
Japan.
page_data.zh:
-2-

3. 发电厂
江南兵工厂拥有自己的发电设备，但也从南市的中国电厂获取电力供应。
共有电动机 22 台，马力范围从 10 到 40 不等。

4. 机械 各部门的机械均为德国制造，由卡洛维茨公司（Carlowitz & Co.）供应。

5. 人员
兵工厂总监
{
总务处
{
总务科
预算科
会计科
采购科
卫生科
工务处
{
仓储部
各工务部门主管，
如火炮部等。

职员人数为 250 人，工人数为 3,360 人。

6. 材料
炸药几乎全部从德国购买。
铁、铜和黄铜均为中国产品，由中国金属公司供应。
钢材由专门的炼钢部生产，月产量高达约 180 担，但目前因缺乏资金而停产。
引信：制造引信的材料从日本购买。

SHANGHAI AREA,
SHANGHAI.

September 24th 1929.

Dear Aiers,

KIANGNAN ARSENAL.

I should be very grateful if you would let me have
such information as you have at your disposal in answer to
the attached questionnaire.

I am opening a new file on this subject and I would
like to have up to date information as a foundation.

Yours truly,

Lieutenant,
Shanghai Area Intelligence Officer.

R.C. Aiers Esq.,
Director of Criminal Investigation,
Shanghai.

（批：Please see 25/9.）
